static_traits.name: Liu Ruoxuan
static_traits.educational_background: Currently studying for a bachelor's degree
static_traits.social_status: Having friends and family to discuss daily matters with, but finding it hard to open up about low self-esteem and inadequacy
static_traits.medical_history: No prior psychological counseling or treatment history; no major physical illness
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, coherent thinking, able to self-reflect; positive attitude, willing to try new approaches

basic_info.main_problem: I feel my beliefs and values (e.g. valuing recycling) do not make me different from others or feel special, which has led to uselessness and low self-esteem.
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling because these feelings are affecting my mental health and academic performance, making it hard for me to concentrate on studying.
growth_experiences: A low sense of self-worth began appearing in adolescence and persisted after entering college; worsened under academic expectations and social comparison, especially more prone to low self-esteem and inadequacy when interacting with peers of differing views. To relieve this, I tried participating in more environmental actions and connecting with like-minded people, but the sense of uselessness remains.

core_beliefs: I am not important / not special

special_situations.event: Interacting with peers of differing views
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If my views cannot be recognized or appear special, it shows I have no value
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reduced socializing and in-depth expression, to avoid being judged
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will find me ordinary and not worth noticing

special_situations.event: Seeing peers' outstanding achievements in studies or projects
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If my achievements are inferior to others', it proves I am not important / am a failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Constantly comparing myself with others, and trying to prove myself by increasing environmental actions

special_situations.event: Classroom discussions or publicly expressing personal beliefs
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If my speech is not impressive enough, I will be dismissed and ignored
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding speaking in class, reducing expressing opinions in public settings
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will be looked down on or ignored

special_situations.event: Receives positive feedback or a brief sense of achievement after organizing environmental activities
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Unless I do more and bigger, none of this counts
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Dismissing positive experiences, immediately raising standards and pressuring myself
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This is nothing; I should do more

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be seen and recognized, accepted as a unique and valuable person
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being belittled, ignored, or judged after comparison, experiencing shame and worthlessness
defense_goal: Reduces the risk of being judged by avoiding exposing vulnerability and reducing expression
Preventing disappointment and shame through self-deprecation and dismissing positive experiences
Relies on external standards and comparison to maintain a controllable self-positioning

object_relations.self_representation: An ordinary, unimportant person who is easily overlooked
object_relations.object_representation: Judgmental others / peers with higher achievements who easily dismiss me

object_relations.self_representation: A person who may become a burden and needs to hide vulnerability
object_relations.object_representation: People who would look down on me or be held back by me because of my inadequacy

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor or others affirm one's efforts and contributions
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believing the other person is comforting or exaggerating, and my achievements do not count
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Downplaying positive feedback, using expressions like 'it is actually nothing' and 'I just did a very small thing', in a low-key, avoidant tone

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When invited to express views in class or sessions
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believing others will hold a dismissive or contemptuous attitude toward my views
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Avoiding direct answers, using vague and reserved language, reducing details, lowering voice and shortening speech

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the topic touches on painful emotions and worthlessness
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Instead discusses abstract value and efficiency to replace emotional experience, in order to maintain control
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Using objective analysis and conceptual language (e.g. 'from an efficiency perspective', 'in theory'), avoiding describing specific feelings and needs

manifestations: Believing personal efforts like recycling do not make me special, and contributions seem insignificant
After comparing with others' achievements, feels one's own worth and meaning diminished
outcomes: Decreased attention and participation in learning
Reduced motivation, fewer extracurricular activities and self-care

manifestations: Although there are family and friends to discuss daily matters with, finding it hard to open up about low self-esteem and inadequacy
Worries about becoming a burden or being looked down on, chooses to bear it alone
outcomes: Emotionally lacking support, intensifying cycle of negative emotions

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the urge to do something to other people or things, or gives up seeking others to do something for them, turning to do it to themselves instead — i.e. redirecting libidinal energy toward the self
manifestations: Not seeking help from family and friends when feeling low self-esteem, choosing to digest it alone
Reducing speaking in class and social settings to avoid being judged

contact_model.definition: There is maladaptive self-reflection and self-restriction, including excessive self-reproach, being overly cautious about contact
manifestations: Excessively worries about others' evaluations before expressing views, and then reduces expression

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others
manifestations: Assuming others will look down on or dismiss my views
Anticipating being ignored or judged in social situations

exception_events.target_problem: In social / learning scenarios requiring expression and participation, Liu Ruoxuan usually reduces expression or withdraws due to low self-esteem and fear of judgment, feeling more worthless afterwards.
exception_events.unique_outcome: At certain times proactively organizing environmental activities and attracting classmates to join, feeling proud and affirmed in the moment, with fewer thoughts of 'my efforts do not count'
exception_events.reason: Clue: different approach — proactively taking the organizer role; different support — peer participation and positive feedback; different understanding — seeing concrete impact (others joining) makes value more visible

positive_force: Stable values and investment in environmental action (can organize activities and influence others)
Has some organizational and mobilizing ability (has gained others' participation and affirmation)
Basic family and friend support network (though hard to open up, daily matters can be discussed)
Open and positive attitude toward counseling, willing to try changing
Able to self-reflect, identifying comparison and belittling thinking patterns
negative_force: Excessive social comparison, relies on external recognition to define self-worth
Dismissing positive experiences and the 'should' self-reproach pattern
Anticipation of judgment leading to avoidance of social and classroom participation
Low self-esteem and a sense of meaninglessness reinforcing a negative cycle
Academic pressure and comparison with peers' achievements intensifying the not-good-enough belief

target_behavior.behavior: In socializing and class discussions, avoiding speaking and expressing opinions
antecedent: Interacting with peers of differing views
Class discussion requires speaking up publicly
Notices others' more prominent achievements or leadership roles
target_behavior.core_reason: Long-term social comparison and dependence on external recognition triggering fear of being judged and shame, maintaining the belief 'I am not good enough'
target_behavior.function: Avoiding unwelcome outcomes (being dismissed / shame), reducing anxiety in the short term
target_behavior.consequence: Impaired academic participation and learning experience, reduced social connections, further reinforcing worthlessness

target_behavior.behavior: Dismissing positive feedback and achievements (belittling self contributions)
antecedent: Receives positive feedback or a brief sense of achievement after organizing activities
Others affirming his effort or influence
target_behavior.core_reason: Driven by excessively high inner 'should' standards and self-worth schemas (unworthy / unimportant), excluding positive evidence to maintain consistency
target_behavior.function: Avoiding disappointment and maintaining a controllable self-positioning through Self-denial
target_behavior.consequence: Positive experiences cannot be internalized, self-esteem hard to improve, persistent meaninglessness and inadequacy
